Scroll groups reveal at clamped top 86%, scale .98 to 1, opacity 0 to 1, 28px travel (16px mobile), stagger capped .24s (.16s mobile). Keyboard focus completes its group; reduced motion reverts poses.

narrative.overview:
An editorial, minimal portfolio built around confident typography, generous space, and a uniform neutral canvas. Geist gives display headings their structure; Manrope identifies entries and articles; Inter keeps reading and controls clear; Instrument Serif italic adds selective emphasis.

The approved raphael-design identity pairs with Apple-inspired immediate feedback and restrained motion. Content stays visible without JavaScript animation, while light and dark themes preserve the same hierarchy. Decorative glass and ornamental gradients are outside this visual direction.
keyCharacteristics: Uniform neutral surfaces and fine separators.
Expressive headings with selective italic serif emphasis.
Open editorial grids, compact controls, and clear keyboard feedback.

rules.name: The Semantic Theme Rule
rules.body: Use the existing semantic variables so every surface and control follows the selected theme.

rules.name: The Selective Serif Rule
rules.body: Keep serif emphasis inside headings rather than making it the default reading face.

dos: Do use the existing semantic CSS variables for both themes.
Do reserve Instrument Serif italic for selective heading emphasis.
Do preserve visible focus, disabled states, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do use open lists and separators for trajectory, technologies, and articles.
donts: Don't add decorative glass, ornamental gradients, or navigation-delaying animation.
Don't turn every content group into a raised card.
Don't introduce accent colors or additional font families without a new visual decision.
